text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing training with Smart Falcon...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! An empty training track,
twilight, magic hour...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All the ideal conditions are met!
This is truly the ultimate opportunity☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Why, for some dramatic training, of course!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A touching Umadol documentary just isn't complete
without scenes of unseen hard work♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And so... pretty please, Trainer☆
Falco can do some extra training now, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And so... pretty please, Trainer☆
Falco can do some extra training now, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay~!
Now that's what I'm talking about♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well then...
Here you go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you get plenty of great shots
of Falco doing her best, okay?☆
choice_data_list: Don't tell me... for a documentary!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong☆
Spot on~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco is defini-definitely
gonna become a top umadol!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I've gotta make sure to capture lots of precious footage right from now on♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while occasionally staring blatantly straight at the camera,
Smart Falcon worked diligently on her independent training.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?!
Wh-Whyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"This is all so Falco can stand in the center
and become the top Umadol, you know!?"
choice_data_list: Resting is all part of becoming a top Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Jeez... Trainer-san.
That's kinda cheating...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sniff... Okay, I get it...
Falco will make sure to get some proper rest, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even while putting on an exaggerated pout, Smart Falcon still made sure to get plenty of rest.
